about: Galatians is Paul's letter about the freedom we have in Jesus.

pages.title: The Fruit of the Spirit
pages.scene: A tree full of nine kinds of fruit
pages.text: Paul wrote that the Holy Spirit grows good things in us, like fruit on a tree: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.
pages.lesson: Let God grow good fruit in you.

pages.title: Don't Give Up
pages.scene: Friends helping carry a heavy basket
pages.text: "Help carry each other's heavy loads. Don't get tired of doing good. If you don't give up, you will enjoy a good harvest at the right time."
pages.lesson: Keep doing good, and don't give up.
